<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Vande Mataram controversy:</strong> The BJP has launched a scathing attack on the Congress party, labeling it the &quot;New Muslim League&quot; after the CWC decided to recite only the first two stanzas of Vande Mataram at party events.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative updates:</strong> Parliament has passed the Transgender Persons Amendment Bill, 2026, following Rajya Sabha approval, while the Lok Sabha passed the Tribunals Reforms Bill, 2026, to establish a National Tribunals Commission.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOS1Y3RmZzYUVKcWZEU082Q3J2S210X3k5NEVLdmVkbTY2TlBsNFZIR2FoWFBrQTFaMDYwcXE3clIzTDN4VV83US1LUmxwd2FVeVZsNW5YeVZHU0ZMUnJLZjhTVjBnRFE2Y2ZpZTMtOWVqYU1TX3BNTHRvZjhscE1yT1JsRjVFYnFITm9GbVVkNEdkVjFrSTNvYldVUU1zSjlGaVZoZDE3T0x1Vmx5VW5ONnNvc0xxQU5kTlkw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxOTzZNT1FBZEZrYjZUZzBtYXUtZGdTNnNDbzRzclhGTE44ZzhDNjA3OTJXZ2paQlRWLWZpV0NVS3hjNUROdDU0NTM2VkNGZFRFZjRoQWVIbDZQVlRaLTZpVnp6WmhTZVhTTUw0eUFtX3I4ckhnYXdGbkYySlJjMGp3OHY0SXVNTGEtTHVPMWF6TFVIOFY1cE1nN1FPeUFlRktaZEhyUnhDdEcza2xHempvVkIwcS1HN2ltbUt3UERCM3htaUc5b3c?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial developments:</strong> The Supreme Court has upheld the constitutional validity of the death penalty by hanging and is set to hear a challenge from former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal against his rape conviction and 10-year sentence.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxOSS1EUndpRjR1cnpLTHpFazNaZHZIdWNrcWJ2SC1UY3dDMXc3OXNDVVVEQWdvcEJHSm9tY1M1MW02allPb1lYZ1lNZTFoX0F6VmRTQllLbXhGOHV4ajdtT3R6MVA2SURMZTUyMFd0TGNVc3lxS2NfejNUc0F2RVZnXzB0S0VER2lDNm5XYldndDRxQmNGUlJDVDR2bV8tYmdBbFNtcVFja0N4X1Uybm16R0hrY0E?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxOU19XWFdudDZwUDlaRkJGbmcwcVNSMmZRbU9TZlBhUXdvdTJSN2g0NUN1UTZLWDljUXdRVHRpbXJaY2dQSkY1NnpfUE1JeE0yNkF1SE51Nm5LMFJDaTMxbFJqTVloTHpVT2s5cE9rU1NkaXBCcHRiTUI3b1VGT3hlODY2aGs?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Women’s reservation setback:</strong> A Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at providing reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the Lok Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W18</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral and regional shifts:</strong> The Election Commission has revised the schedule for Delhi’s electoral rolls, while the TMC secured a significant victory in the Bengal Bar Council polls, winning 15 seats against the BJP&#x27;s three.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W21</a></span></li>
</ul>
